summary: In Greek mythology, Immaradus was a Thracian prince, the son of King Eumolpus of Thrace and the Oceanid Daeira. During the war between Eleusis and Athens he led the Thracian forces fighting on the side of Eleusis. He was killed by Erechtheus, king of Athens.

sections.heading: Overview
paragraphs: In Greek mythology, Immaradus (Ancient Greek: Ἰμμάραδος, Immarados) was a Thracian prince.

sections.heading: Family
paragraphs: Immaradus was the son of King Eumolpus of Thrace and the Oceanid Daeira.

sections.heading: Mythology
paragraphs: During the war between Eleusis and Athens, Immaradus led the Thracian armies on the side of Eleusis.
He was killed by Erechtheus, king of Athens.
